method: Median of observed rounded first-token prefill rates within each trial, then median across trials. Partial provider-turn coverage, not duration-weighted aggregate throughput or pure prefill time. All attempts are represented, including failures and the original infrastructure exclusion.
caveats: Internal tool-loop requests, cancelled turns and event-stream gaps may be absent. Coverage of every request is not asserted.
Only exact recorded duplicates can be detected; reconnect replay without stable event IDs cannot be identified.
Time to first token includes other work and cannot substitute for prefill duration. Rounded rates and trial token totals cannot reconstruct exact durations.
These observations must not be treated as the same estimator as llama.cpp aggregate prompt tokens divided by prompt-evaluation seconds.
